title: Orthogonal projection onto a hyperplane Q of A₀ with unit normal n: P_Q = P_{A₀} − n⊗n (parent steps 1, 3 and 7a)
statement: Hyperplane projection in A₀. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; linear subspaces A₀, Q ⊆ ℝ^P; n ∈ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: dim A₀ = m + 1; dim Q = m; Q ⊆ A₀; n ∈ A₀; |n| = 1; n·v = 0 for every v ∈ Q. Conclusion: for every w ∈ ℝ^P, P_Q w = P_{A₀}w − (n·w)n, where P_Q and P_{A₀} are the orthogonal projections onto Q and A₀ (Submodule.starProjection).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (n : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → Module.finrank ℝ Q = m → Q ≤ A₀ → n ∈ A₀ → ‖n‖ = 1 → (∀ v ∈ Q, inner ℝ n v = 0) → ∀ w : Euclid P, Q.starProjection w = A₀.starProjection w - inner ℝ n w • n
